description: Beyond the docking concourse, thousands of ships occupy berths stretching into the distance, while cargo moves through vast automated handling systems and streams of passengers pour into and out of the Habitat. The constant movement of ships, people and freight makes it clear that Proxima is the great crossroads of human space.
name: Proxima Habitat Terminal
short_desc: The central arrivals and departures terminal on Proxima Habitat.

description: A legendary bar where off-duty crews trade rumours and bad jokes, open 24/7. The lights and the ceiling are low and the air smells of synth-whiskey and beer. Windows look directly onto the docking concourse; ships drift slowly past while crews come and go. The unofficial passenger charter market is simply another part of the background conversation.
name: Davidsons
short_desc: Pilot bar where off-duty crews trade rumours and bad jokes.

description: Skyedge is where you start when you want to build a ship. Large or small, we have a frame to suit your needs. The showroom is dominated by bare spacecraft chassis: clean, unfitted hulls suspended in individual display cradles or arranged across a vast orbital lot. Register your hull and fit it out at the Shipyard.
name: Skyedge Space Ships
short_desc: Ship chassis dealer and frame registrar.

description: Orbital lot of complete light civilian hulls, trade-ins welcome. Used and trade-in civilian ships line the showroom, ready to fly. The showroom occupies a sprawling orbital lot within the Habitat, with completed light civilian vessels arranged in long rows beneath enormous illuminated canopies.
name: Concord Scouts
short_desc: No finer place to purchase new or used space craft.

description: Centauri is the habitat's largest shipyard. Outfitting bays for all manner of ship systems cram the giant warehouses, glittering with arc welders and angle grinders. Ships sit in heavy maintenance cradles while crews work around them, installing modules of all kinds. You must supply at least a registered chassis.
name: Centauri Shipyard
short_desc: Outfitting bays for installing systems on docked ships.

description: Enormous market displays track commodities and contracts in real time while automated systems continuously adjust prices and execute transactions. Traders, brokers and corporate representatives occupy quieter workspaces overlooking the exchange, intervening when they need to negotiate unusual contracts or manage large positions.
name: Proxima Central Exchange
short_desc: Automated commodity exchange for interplanetary trade categories.

description: Hard-worn terminal above Tycho. Ore shuttles and industrial traffic share the lanes.
name: Tycho Terminal

description: Ore-hauler cradles and quake-braced gantries dominate the Tycho yards. Crews fit armour and industrial systems while eclipse shutters roll across the observation decks.
name: Tycho Heavy Yards
short_desc: Heavy outfitting bays for industrial traffic above Tycho.

description: Resort terminal with customs and docking lanes overlooking the ocean.

description: Polished fitting docks above La Bella Vista's oceans. Yacht crews mix with charter pilots while modules are installed behind tinted viewports.
